row.notes: Ctor (vtable 0x1459b5748) for a per-model-instance skeleton pose. Reads skeleton: +0 u16 boneCount, +0x10 u16 parent table, +0x18 local transforms (0x30 each), +0x20 bind transforms, +0x28 per-bone type bytes (type 2 bones are counted), +0x58/+0x60 128-bit skeleton id. Allocates one block: local (+0x10), composed (+0x18), two history copies (+0x20,+0x28), 3 bitsets of (boneCount+63)/64 words (+0x30..+0x40), identity matrices for type-2 bones; copies local pose, calls Ne_AnimPose_ComposeParentMatrices, and looks up/creates a refcounted shared table for type-2 bones in global map 0x146545d28 keyed by skeleton id (under CS 0x146545d30). +0x60 flag = all parents zero (flat hierarchy), +0x7c boneCount. Ends by queueing job FUN_143d6da10 on allocator/job iface 0x146c641e0. Hook point for bone data of a spawned model.
